source_evidence_statements: research/voice-enhancement-20261101/candidate_matrix.csv records 'HuBERT / WavLM-based conversion' as unavailable/blocked: no end-to-end mapper/decoder or local conversion checkpoint, and representations alone do not produce converted speech.

research/voice-enhancement-20261101/agent-transform-space/REPORT.md records HuBERT as 'researched but not run': no local encoder or downstream VC benchmark, and an encoder is only one frozen component of a fully specified VC pipeline.
research/accent-conversion-20261101/README.md records 'HuBERT / WavLM encoders' as content encoders, not accent converters, and not tested as standalone models.

research/voice-conversion-eval-20261101/repos/rvc is pinned at 81eed5e8 under an MIT LICENSE; its infer/hubert.py loads a transformers HubertModelWithFinalProj from assets/hubert_base and declares v1 = hidden_states[9] through final_proj (256-wide) and v2 = last_hidden_state (768-wide).

assets/hubert_base contains only config.json and preprocessor_config.json as untracked working-tree files; the required pytorch_model.bin is absent. No mapper, decoder/vocoder or matched conversion checkpoint is present anywhere checked.

The config declares a 768-wide, 12-layer HubertModelWithFinalProj with conv_stride [5,2,2,2,2,2] (320-sample, 50 Hz content rate), classifier_proj_size 256, torch_dtype float16 and transformers 4.49.0; these are static declarations, not measured behaviour.

No standalone HuBERT conversion timing, feature, content-fidelity, listening, device or release result exists locally; the RVC whole-file pipeline timing is a different system and is not attributed to this component.
